commerce.categoryHelp: A clear scope. A trusted partner. One shared outcome.
commerce.discoverHelp: Find a brief that fits your expertise. Propose an outcome, agree on the terms, and collaborate.
commerce.protection: Built around both sides of the agreement
commerce.protectionBody: Commission with a clear acceptance standard. Deliver with payment secured before you begin.
commerce.buyerBody: Publish your brief, review proposals, and confirm the scope before locking payment.
commerce.sellerBody: Find a matching brief, propose your approach, and start after funding is confirmed.
commerce.questionOne: When does payment reach the delivery partner?
commerce.answerOne: After the agreed milestone passes review. Hybrid review requires your approval after AI checks; AI verification can settle a passing milestone automatically.
commerce.questionTwo: Does posting a brief lock any funds?
commerce.answerTwo: No. A brief and proposals are offchain. After selecting a partner, confirm the collaboration and lock funds with your wallet.
commerce.answerThree: The checks agreed in advance: page availability, required content, performance, and a bounded requirement rubric. A failed check does not release payment.
commerce.closing: Your next collaboration starts with a conversation about the outcome.
commerce.closingBody: Share what you need. Agree on what done looks like.
commerce.footer: Clear agreements. Protected payments. Verifiable outcomes.

form.noWorkerDeposit: No deposit is required from the delivery partner.
form.protectionHelp: The commissioner secures the project payment before work starts. The delivery partner contributes the agreed work, without an upfront deposit.
form.optionalDeposit: Commissioner deposit is optional. Set it to 0 if you do not need additional collateral. It is returned on normal completion.
form.descriptionHint: 20–12,000 characters. Include scope and expected delivery.
form.localTime: Dates are shown in your local time. Leave at least one hour before delivery.
form.urlHint: Enter the full http:// or https:// address.
form.fixFields: Please fix the following before continuing:
form.descriptionLength: Description must contain 20–12,000 characters. Explain the scope and deliverables.
form.requirementsLength: Requirements must be at most 8,000 characters.
form.skillsLength: Use at most 12 skills, with no more than 40 characters each.
form.positiveAmount: Amount must be greater than 0, at most 1,000,000 USDC, with up to 6 decimal places.
form.nonnegativeAmount: Deposit must be between 0 and 1,000,000 USDC, with up to 6 decimal places.
form.futureDeadline: Set a deadline at least one hour from now.
form.milestoneTitle: Each milestone needs a title of 1–160 characters.
form.beforeDeadline: Milestone deadline must not be later than the project deadline.
form.orderedDeadlines: Milestone deadlines must be in order, at least one hour from now, and within the project deadline.
form.milestoneTotal: Milestone amounts must add up to the project budget.
form.websiteUrl: Enter a valid website URL beginning with http:// or https://.
form.scoreRange: Score must be a whole number between 0 and 100.
form.policyMismatch: Verification rules must match the selected review method.
form.serverField: This field has an invalid value. Please check its format and length.
form.totalHint: Milestone total: {total} USDC · Project budget: {budget} USDC
form.clientMode: You review each milestone before releasing payment.
form.hybridMode: AI checks the agreed requirements. You review the evidence and confirm payment.
form.aiMode: A passing AI check automatically releases payment for the milestone.
form.acceptWithoutDeposit: Confirm the collaboration to start delivery. You do not need to pay a deposit.
